Lower Text: [Security] Play this card without paying its memory cost.
Upper Text: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 Digimon card with [X Antibody] in its traits and 1 Option card with [X Antibody] in its traits among them to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order. [Your Turn] When one of your Digimon digivolves into a same-level Digimon with [X Antibody] in its traits, you may suspend this Tamer to gain 1 memory and ＜Draw 1＞.
